title: CYCLIC-QSCALE: retuned quarter-log profile with a negative curvature correction in charged work

It recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 under independent ideal copies. All outside constants are absolute, independent of N,s and outcomes. Here , the exact Pell rational u_333/v_333 of cyclic_base.md Section 0. The exact growth index is 1/2.
